fusions.name: Scurry Spit
fusions.desc: Spits 3 droplets at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage and having a 20% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pounce From Cover
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Under the Duckweed
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Crumb Thief
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying an affliction, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
